primary_rule: pooled numeric availability strictly greater than 40 percent after technical screening
candidate_selection: maximum equal-capture S20, then availability, then lower conditional mean width/height MAE
failure_denominators: All attempted target/configuration pairs retained; missing measurements count as unavailable and not within tolerances. Conditional errors use numeric results.
grouping: Visually assigned front groups, not independently confirmed physical identity; equal-capture primary estimand
confidence_status: Original heterogeneous operating points retained. No common-rule optimized or geometrically replayed 27-capture claim.
